implementation: Readable handwritten C99 central differences, initial finite-decimal step selection and Richardson extrapolation; no CPU or ROM execution and no host floating-point substitute

implemented_routines.name: central-difference sampling
implemented_routines.scope: LocalX plus thenminus callback order, original cancellation-suppressed difference, division by2h, normalization and integer cleanup

implemented_routines.name: derivative precision and extrapolation driver
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared real point/tolerance contract, default1e-10, explicit positive toleranceF8 gate, halved-step Richardson triangle, relative error, decade-gated best estimate, nativeF1/F3/FB and finite limits

implemented_routines.name: initial step probe
implemented_routines.scope: Signed decimal-power step with minimum1e-93, repeated point validation, at most7domain/relative-ratio probes, original0.9..1.1 gate and step/10 fallback

callback_contract: LocalX follows native0x171ea order. Legacy zero+F means evaluation failure; positive named OK/ERROR distinguishes native condition from successful F-valued variables. Initial probes preserve ignored-condition/record error checks and ordinary arithmetic's bit40 masking. The parser owns native globalX save/restore, bank cleanup and token consumption.
gaps: Standalone API does not parse expression tokens
Complex callbacks and malformed BCD are excluded
Reset/keyscan execution is outside the prepared native oracle
completion: Prepared real scalar differentiation only; complete firmware equivalence remains unproven
